analysis_method: All original mapped segments extracted outside Git; __TEXT file-offset fields relocated for static inspection only. Native original recovery IOKit corroborates named internal functions. No framework or guard changed.

system_addresses.default_client: IOHIDEventSystemClientCreate0x181305dcc sets client type3 and tailcalls CreateWithType.
system_addresses.entitlement_source: Connection creation copies audit-token entitlements, reads literal com.apple.private.hid.client.event-dispatch at0x181333488, compares xpc Boolean true at0x181333498 and sets bit3 at0x181333494-4c0. Internal-build alternate is a separate branch, not required when ordinary entitlement true.
system_addresses.server_gate: __io_hideventsystem_dispatch_event0x1813380bc gets connection type; nonzero type must have bit3 at0x181338134. Type0 admin is separately entitlement-gated during creation; default3 avoids admin privileges.
system_addresses.event_route: After gate, server reconstructs IOHIDEvent from serialized CFData at0x181338154, logs event then invokes __IOHIDEventSystemDispatchEvent0x181338174. That forwards to session dispatch0x181302da8-dac; __IOHIDSessionDispatchEvent0x1813187f0 enqueues original event and signals session queue. No emulated MT/SPI packet required by this route.
system_addresses.return_limit: Denied dispatch logs missing entitlement but rejoins return0 at0x181338190. Return0 therefore cannot prove event accepted, routed to display, or UI acted.

limits: This proves one original server authorization gate, not complete display routing. Digitizer event fields, display integration and context requirements need original caller/consumer evidence.
No synthetic unlock notification, no event-filter/admin entitlement, no guard bypass, and no claim that MT-SPI milestone is solved.
Only ordinary UI input through original APIs is contemplated; actual receiver/UI evidence remains required.
